verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, so user-configurable background automations are a software capability outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships an automation or agent feature. The AI-acceleration and voice-command mentions describe hardware support for third-party apps, not autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
